evidence.detail: Smaller company ($1M-$20M traded a day) + 2 or more insiders each buying $25k+ within 30 days + operating cash flow above reported profit. In our tests: about +2.4% (2014-2022) and +2.7% (2023-2026) per trade above the S&P 500 over 60 days, on average. The most consistent result found, not a guarantee; many trades still lose.
